citations.title: Novartis appoints Mukul Mehta as Chief Financial Officer, as Harry Kirsch retires after 22 years with the company

sentences.quote: Mukul Mehta, currently Head of Business Planning and Analysis (BPA), Digital Finance and Tax, has been appointed Chief Financial Officer, effective March 16, 2026, and will join the Executive Committee (ECN)
sentences.text: Mukul Mehta became chief financial officer and joined the Executive Committee of Novartis on March 16, 2026, succeeding Harry Kirsch, who stepped down on March 15 and retired after a 22-year career and more than 12 years on the committee.

Chief executive Vas Narasimhan said on July 21, 2026 that there was "no change of plans" for him and that he would lead the company through its next phase of growth, citing second-half trial readouts, next year's launches and a continuing AI transformation; he was appointed to the board of the AI firm Anthropic in April 2026.
At the 2026 annual general meeting, shareholders backed the board's resolutions and elected Elizabeth McNally to the Compensation Committee.

thesis_pillars.text: Novartis AG is a "pure-play" innovative medicines company focused on four core therapeutic areas, cardiovascular-renal-metabolic, immunology, neuroscience and oncology, with investment prioritized in gene and cell therapy, radioligand therapy and xRNA platforms and in the priority markets of the US, China, Germany and Japan. Priority brands drive growth, with second-quarter 2026 sales up 43% in constant currencies for Kisqali, 32% for Kesimpta, 43% for Pluvicto and 59% for Leqvio. Pipeline and dealmaking add optionality, including the completed Avidity acquisition, which adds three late-stage neuromuscular medicines. Cash generation is strong, with second-quarter 2026 free cash flow of USD 5.6 billion.
